design_philosophy.identity: Experience OS - Premium, High-Contrast, Swiss-inspired, Trust-centric
core_principles: No More 'AI Slop': Remove repetitive soft-green icon chips and washed-out dark colors.
Signature vs Commodity: 'Digital Twin' and 'Interior Design' must have hero-level, photography-backed cards. Commodities get clean, typographic minimal treatments.
The 'Bento' Protocol: On desktop, never stretch mobile columns. Use asymmetrical grids (e.g., col-span-8 and col-span-4) with generous max-widths (max-w-7xl).
Floating Element Resolution: Implement a unified 'Command Dock'. Cookie banners must be top-fixed. WhatsApp/AI Chat merge into a single 'Assistant' FAB to prevent bottom-right collisions.
Optical Clarity: Use true blacks (#0A0A0A) in dark mode with crisp 1px borders (#222). No muddy navy. In light mode, stark white with high-contrast text.

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure these fonts are loaded via Google Fonts or local assets. Strict adherence to tracking and leading is required.

headings.usage: Use font-light (300) for massive hero text to create elegance, or font-bold (700) for punchy metric numbers.

colors.theme_strategy: Dual Theme (Light/Dark). The user left it to the designer. We are pivoting to 'Electric Luminous' combined with 'Deep Obsidian'.

brand_accent.description: Luminous Chartreuse/Acid Yellow. Replaces the old soft lime for a sharper, tech-forward 'Experience OS' feel.

surfaces.cards: Flat background, 1px solid border matching theme border, subtle shadow only in light mode. NO muddy backgrounds.
surfaces.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 dark:bg-black/60 border border-white/20 dark:border-white/10. Used exclusively for sticky headers and the floating dock.

1_public_client_funnel.desktop_layout: Split-screen or Centered Max-W-3xl container for the wizard. Not a stretched mobile view.

components.Hero: H1: 'Ce vrei să rezolvi azi?' in Outfit Light. Search input with large, plush padding.
components.Trust_Strip: Horizontal flex, text-xs uppercase, separated by bullets. Icons: ShieldCheck, Clock, Zap.
components.Signature_Cards: Digital Twin & Interior Design must span full width or 2-col. Background image with black/40 overlay. White text, bottom-left aligned. Action button: Glass pill.
components.Commodity_Cards: Grid of 6. Clean white/dark boxes, no background image. Minimalist lucide icon in top left, text bottom left. NO repeating soft-green background chips.
components.Wizard_Flow: Clean radio lists. Progress bar at top (1px height, brand accent color). Sticky bottom CTA.

2_client_dashboard_v2.desktop_layout: Sidebar nav or Slim Top Nav. Main content max-w-7xl using High Density Grid (Bento).

components.Hero_Card: State-driven. State C (Active Job): 4-step progress pills using text-sm, brand accent active state. Huge primary CTA 'Plătește avansul'.
components.Quick_Actions_Grid: 2x2 crisp squares. 'Întreabă AI' gets a special 'Tracing Beam' border or subtle gradient glow to stand out.
components.AI_Copilot: Distinct surface (e.g., slight tint of the brand accent background at 5% opacity). 'Rezumat AI' button.
components.Discover_Row: Horizontal scroll (hide scrollbar). High-quality image cards for Digital Twin/House Health.

3_specialist_entry_home.description: Simplified entry tier. Maximize urgency and clarity.

components.Checklist_Card: Vertical stepped list. Active step highlighted, inactive muted. Progress bar.
components.Opportunities_List: Rows. Each row: Title, robust budget tag (font-mono for numbers), 'URGENT' chip (Red/Orange accent), and 'Acceptă' CTA.

4_specialist_dashboard_full.desktop_layout: Full width dashboard. Left sidebar for navigation.

components.KPI_Cards: 4 column grid. Huge numbers (font-outfit font-light text-5xl). Subtle labels.
components.Pipeline_Bani_Cockpit: Bento box. 2x2 grid inside a larger card. Highlight '+117%' in bright green.
components.Bottom_Nav_Mobile: Floating pill, backdrop-blur, containing the 4 primary destinations with count badges.

collision_resolution.instructions: The user complained about overlapping floating elements (Cookie, WhatsApp, AI Chat, Bottom Nav).

solution.Cookie_Banner: Must be fixed to the TOP of the screen as a slim inline strip, pushing body content down. NEVER floating at the bottom.
solution.Chat_and_Support: Combine WhatsApp and AI Chat into a single 'Assistant' FAB located at bottom-right (bottom-24 on mobile to clear nav, bottom-8 on desktop). Clicking it opens a small popover to choose AI or WhatsApp.
solution.Mobile_Bottom_Nav: Strictly z-50. Fixed bottom-0 w-full glassmorphic bar. No other floating elements exist at bottom-0.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do NOT use 'transition: all'. Explicitly use 'transition-transform transition-colors'.
Never center align the main .App container text.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
Do NOT use placeholder image URLs. Use the provided high-quality image_urls for the signature services.
Make sure dark mode colors are crisp (#0A0A0A) and not washed out navy blues.
Use Lucide-react icons, but do NOT wrap them in repetitive colored square backgrounds for every single card. Let them breathe.
